description: This pie chart illustrates the proportional distribution of twelve different topical categories. The chart does not utilize a separate legend or place percentage labels inside the slices; instead, category names and their corresponding percentages are located outside the chart, connected to each segment by thin gray leader lines. Moving clockwise from the top right, the slices include a large blue segment with a partially cut-off label beginning with "AI/NLP" at 24.3%, followed by a red slice for "Business" (5.9%), a yellow slice for "Geography" (2.7%), a small green slice for "Math" (1.2%), and an orange slice for "Game&Anime" (8.2%). Continuing clockwise, there is a large teal slice with a partially visible label ending in "...Fin" where the percentage is cut off from view, a light blue slice for "Science" (6.7%), a pink slice for "Law" (5.1%), a yellow slice for "History" (8.2%), a green slice for "Med & Health" (6.7%), an orange slice for "Pet & Animal" (5.5%), and finally a light teal slice for "Daily Life" (7.1%). The segments do not appear to be ordered by size in either an ascending or descending fashion, and none of the individual slices are visually emphasized, exploded, or offset from the main body of the pie.
